id.meaning: Notification identifier from the old route path.

schema.meaning: Schema on local success and refusal; a forwarded gateway reply is preserved.

ok.meaning: True when the gateway updates the row, false on a local refusal.

id.meaning: The supplied notification identifier on gateway success.

hidden.meaning: The fixed hidden value written on gateway success.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists locally generated literal refusals. A forwarded, bound gateway reply is passed through and can carry firstMissingSignal of any JSON type.
